hook.line: A new type of content is starting to crush on social media.
hook.visual: Light grid board titled 'This New Type Of Content Is Going Crazy Viral' fills with a 3x2 grid of video thumbnails, each getting a green view-count badge; his face sits below.

beats.what: Thumbnail grid animates in, green view-count badges (4.1M, 3.1M...) stamp on one by one
Cut to dark board 'This Is How Social Media Used To Look Like Before': profile grid splits into Entertainment and Educational boxes
Timeline scrolls sideways to 2024 with red dots marking each year
Example storytelling video card dropped onto the timeline
Title switches to 'This Is How AI Changed Social Media Forever', timeline moves to 2026
Education splits into three boxes: Application, Tactical Edu, and a blurred third
Graphics drop away; cut to full-frame face for the definitions
Full map returns with Storytelling, Application and Tactical Edu highlighted green
Red-banner 'Comment Format To Get The Doc' over a grid of document pages

why_it_works: View-count badges on a wall of thumbnails prove the trend is real before he names it
A timeline that scrolls from 2023 to 2026 turns an abstract idea into a story with a before and after
Third category left blurred, so the viewer waits for it to be named (edu slop)
Comment-a-keyword lead magnet with a visible stack of pages makes the reward concrete
weaknesses: The middle stretch (about 47-82 s) is plain talking head after a heavy graphic opening, so energy dips
Face is small in the split-screen part (median height 0.12), so expression carries little
Low loop score (0.554): the end board looks nothing like the opening
for_robert: Use a simple animated diagram above his head (timeline or boxes) that builds as he talks; keep one item blurred or hidden so the reveal holds attention, and let Fred point at it.
